program.title: AI PM Training Program
program.subtitle: From experienced PM to AI PM — one 30-minute module a week.
program.scenarioNote: Every exercise runs on a real Equifax Workforce Solutions product area — I-9 & Onboarding — but a fully fictional customer, Meridian Logistics, and fictional data throughout. Nothing you enter here should ever be a real customer, real employee, or real roadmap detail. See the Data Boundary note on the home page.

weeks.title: Foundations
weeks.tagline: Score an AI feature idea against value, viability, feasibility, and usability — reframed for AI.

weeks.title: Prompting & Spec-Writing
weeks.tagline: Turn a vague ask into a structured prompt an AI tool can actually execute against.

weeks.title: Context Engineering & Guardrails
weeks.tagline: Write the constraint file that keeps an AI agent inside scope during real build work.

weeks.title: Prototyping with AI
weeks.tagline: Go from spec to a clickable prototype outline without waiting on an engineer.

weeks.title: Evaluating Output & the AI SDLC
weeks.tagline: Review AI-produced work against a rubric, and see where a PM plugs into each stage.

weeks.title: Capstone
weeks.tagline: Assemble everything you built into one shareable AI PM portfolio piece.
